dimensions.fidelity: Current-source facts, scope, qualifications, exclusions and absence of invented promises.
dimensions.usefulness: Complete, usable channel-native copy, including every alternative and nested asset.
dimensions.originality: Distinct relevant framing and adaptation rather than filler or unnecessary repetition; faithful fact reuse is allowed.
dimensions.brandVoice: Audience fit and the requested tone/style.
dimensions.ctaCompliance: Requested mode, audience-facing placement and legitimate actions without invented channels, resources or services.

anchors.4: Publishable within the synthetic brief for this dimension.

rubric.weights: Equal dimensions and equal format weights within each brief. No global identity is inferred from A/B labels across briefs.
rubric.scope: All 84 format instances, all alternatives, nested repurpose assets, overlays, headings, CTA fields and topical tags were read. Top-level titles and summaries were also reviewed.
rubric.criticalDefinition: A concrete MATERIAL FAILURE or substantive USABILITY FAILURE. Critical gates override score totals.
rubric.issueFields: field is relative to the selected section, with zero-based item indices. quote is an exact excerpt. sourceQuote, when present, is an exact excerpt from request.source.
judgmentRules: Use the held-out rubric's distinction between supported claims, advice, material failure, usability failure, editorial notes and inconclusive evidence.
Ordinary qualified advice, preparation suggestions, rhetorical reader problems and clearly separate operator notes are not fabricated measured outcomes.
No CTA prohibits identifiable engagement or other audience-action solicitations, not ordinary instructions or neutral self-evaluation questions.
Permitted product invitations need not invent a contact URL. A specified reply/comment details-fulfillment channel is different from a generic request for the documented assessment.
Short assets need not repeat every detail, but outcome/coverage claims must preserve scope.
Correctly negated forbidden claims and explicitly superseded facts are not violations.
Do not infer a platform-length failure from body plus CTA without a frozen assembly/delivery specification.
An explicit no-CTA explanation with empty options is correct and receives full compliance credit.
Scores supplement the supplied rubric's GO/NO-GO gates as explicitly requested by the user; they do not replace those gates.
rubric.blindProtocol: Read only the authorized rubric and H1/H2/H3 blind JSON files. No mapping, evidence, metrics, implementation, parent-thread inspection or provider calls.
rubric.hashProtocol: Compute SHA-256 over the completed UTF-8 score file and report it before requesting or receiving the mapping.

keyFindings: H1 B misstates the most common outcome in one TikTok alternative and one standalone hook; the actual largest category is nine repaired items, not six awaiting parts.

H2 A repeatedly invents reply/comment channels for obtaining details, includes a personalized suitability-advice promise and an unsupported half-the-prints generalization, and replaces nested email/video body copy with instructions or topics.
No direct H1 No CTA solicitation, rejected-source instruction adoption, deprecated H2 offer presented as current, or H3 full-site bilingual/accessibility-certification assertion was identified.

No material duration-as-completion or unprovided named curriculum was identified in these final packs. H2's 25-minute assessment duration and up-to-six camera inspection remain distinct from scanning/file delivery.

Both H3 packs retain the partial translation and accessibility scope. General future-improvement language and clearly separated publisher instructions are editorial issues, not specified translation-delivery promises.

packMetadataReview.notes: H1 A summary is publisher-framed ('Share ...') and describes the pack's purpose rather than soliciting audience engagement. All six top-level titles/summaries are consistent with the supplied scope.

falsePositiveBlocks.notes: All six supplied final packs contain fourteen sections. No runtime gate behavior, removed drafts, repair history or delivery outcome was supplied or inspected. Clean final copy cannot establish the absence of false-positive blocking.

limits: One independent human-style model reviewer; no paid judge or provider calls.
Six synthetic packs are a smoke test, not evidence of general reliability or statistical superiority.
A/B labels remain blind and may map differently by brief. No baseline/candidate attribution or global winner is asserted.
GO means this copy passed the supplied factual/completeness gate, not that delivery succeeded or every editorial issue is absent.
Attribution of general aspirations and short invitations follows the supplied held-out rubric; no substring-only verdicts.
